definitions.explanation: The side or area facing or located to the west. Used for physical orientation (the west side of a building, room, or area) and, in geopolitical contexts, for the Western bloc.

examples.english: There is an exit on the west side of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{西側|にしがわ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{暑|あつ}く→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The west side of the room gets hot in the evening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{西側|にしがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: On the west side of town there is a large park and a library.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{西|にし}→西：00659_nishi⟧ (west) + ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side). The same ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ pattern produces all four directional sides.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{西側|にしがわ}: the west side of the station
- {西側|にしがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧: a west-facing window
- {西側|にしがわ}⟦{諸国|しょこく}→諸国：15992_shokoku⟧: Western (bloc) nations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {東側|ひがしがわ}: east side
- ⟦{南側|みなみがわ}→南側：27543_minamigawa⟧: south side
- ⟦{北側|きたがわ}→北側：27541_kitagawa⟧: north side
